correctness.rationale: Fixing the left-side block order freezes every right-side incident-colour sequence because simplicity gives at most one incident edge per block. A left vertex of degree \(d\) has \(d!\) distinct sequences by properness, and its neighbours forbid at most \(d\) of them. The strict inequality \(d!>d\) for \(d\ge3\) gives independent safe choices at all left vertices. The concatenation therefore proves the claim. Exhaustive finite replay over \(67,404\) proper colourings agrees with the proof but is not used as its basis.
